On the far right upper corner, a large-format abstract canvas in muted tan and ochre hangs partially in frame. Sheer linen curtains diffuse soft daylight from a left window. The overall palette is warm neutral — sand, honey, cognac, charcoal — producing a restful, enveloping atmosphere.
